```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-T79U-54'
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        be.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
)
SELECT SUM(be.qty) AS total_qty
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'CB-2903';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

  SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty
  FROM bill_of_materials
  WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
    AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= end_date)
),
-- recursive expansion for a given root product
expand AS (
  SELECT p.product_id AS root_id, b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
  FROM product p
  JOIN bom b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R50B-44'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root_id, b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
  FROM expand e
  JOIN product c ON c.product_id = e.component_id AND c.make_flag = true
  JOIN bom b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
),
expand2 AS (
  SELECT p.product_id AS root_id, b.component_id, b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
  FROM product p
  JOIN bom b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R79Y-44'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root_id, b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
  FROM expand2 e
  JOIN product c ON c.product_id = e.component_id AND c.make_flag = true
  JOIN bom b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
),
parts1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.component_id
  FROM expand e
  JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id
  WHERE p.make_flag = false
),
parts2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.component_id
  FROM expand2 e
  JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id
  WHERE p.make_flag = false
)
SELECT p.product_number
FROM product p
JOIN parts1 a ON a.component_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN parts2 b ON b.component_id = p.product_id
WHERE b.component_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.product_number;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_expand AS (
    SELECT
        b.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        b.component_id AS component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        be.top_product_id,
        b.component_id,
        be.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_expand be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
),
target AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-T67Y-62'
),
order_lines AS (
    SELECT sol.product_id, sol.order_qty, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Australia'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT SUM(ol.order_qty) AS qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN target t ON t.product_id = ol.product_id
),
contained_demand AS (
    SELECT SUM(ol.order_qty * be.qty) AS qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bom_expand be ON be.top_product_id = ol.product_id
    JOIN target t ON t.product_id = be.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials b
      ON b.assembly_id = be.top_product_id
     AND b.component_id = be.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= ol.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= b.end_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM direct_demand), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM contained_demand), 0) AS total_demand;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
target AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FK-1639'
),
-- explode each order line into itself + all components (valid on order date)
exploded AS (
    SELECT sol.order_id, sol.product_id AS root_product, sol.order_qty AS root_qty,
           sol.product_id AS comp_id, 1.0::DOUBLE AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.order_date) = 2023
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.order_id, e.root_product, e.root_qty,
           bom.component_id,
           e.qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom
      ON bom.assembly_id = e.comp_id
     AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = e.order_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= so.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bom.end_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.root_qty * e.qty_per_unit), 0) AS total_demand
FROM exploded e
JOIN target t ON t.product_id = e.comp_id;
```

```sql
    SELECT parent_code, child_code, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2024-12-31'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-01')
),
exploded AS (
    SELECT sol.order_id, sol.product_id, p.product_number AS root_code,
           p.product_number AS code, CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS mult, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id)
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    WHERE st.country_code = 'CA'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.order_id, e.product_id, e.root_code,
           b.child_code, CAST(e.mult * b.qty AS DOUBLE), e.order_date
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN bom b ON b.parent_code = e.code
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = b.parent_code AND uc.child_code = b.child_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= e.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= e.order_date)
)
SELECT SUM(sol.order_qty * e.mult) AS total_demand
FROM exploded e
JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = e.order_id AND sol.product_id = e.product_id
WHERE e.code = 'FK-1639';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Explode BOM as of a given date, tracking quantity per unit of root
explode AS (
  SELECT
    'FR-T98U-60'::VARCHAR AS root_code,
    c.child_code AS item_code,
    c.qty AS qty,
    DATE '2021-05-16' AS as_of
  FROM u_composition c
  WHERE c.parent_code = 'FR-T98U-60'
    AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2021-05-16'
    AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2021-05-16' <= c.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    e.root_code,
    c.child_code,
    e.qty * c.qty,
    e.as_of
  FROM explode e
  JOIN product p ON p.product_number = e.item_code AND p.make_flag = true
  JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = e.item_code
  WHERE c.valid_from <= e.as_of
    AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.as_of <= c.valid_to)
),
qty_2021 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS q
  FROM explode
  WHERE item_code = 'MS-0253'
),
explode_cur AS (
  SELECT
    'FR-T98U-60'::VARCHAR AS root_code,
    c.child_code AS item_code,
    c.qty AS qty,
    DATE '2025-06-30' AS as_of
  FROM u_composition c
  WHERE c.parent_code = 'FR-T98U-60'
    AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
    AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= c.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    e.root_code,
    c.child_code,
    e.qty * c.qty,
    e.as_of
  FROM explode_cur e
  JOIN product p ON p.product_number = e.item_code AND p.make_flag = true
  JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = e.item_code
  WHERE c.valid_from <= e.as_of
    AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.as_of <= c.valid_to)
),
qty_cur AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS q
  FROM explode_cur
  WHERE item_code = 'MS-0253'
)
SELECT (SELECT q FROM qty_cur) - (SELECT q FROM qty_2021) AS change_qty;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Start with FR-M21S-42 as the top-level assembly
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        p.product_id AS root_product_id,
        1.0 AS cumulative_qty
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FR-M21S-42'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand BOM components
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id AS assembly_id,
        bt.root_product_id,
        bt.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = bt.assembly_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
      AND p.make_flag = true  -- Only continue recursion for manufactured (assembly) components
),
-- Get all leaf nodes (parts) with their cumulative quantities
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        bt.assembly_id AS part_id,
        bt.cumulative_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    LEFT JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = bt.assembly_id
        AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    WHERE bom.bom_id IS NULL  -- No BOM means it's a leaf node (part)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include direct components that are parts (make_flag = false)
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id AS part_id,
        bt.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = bt.assembly_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
      AND p.make_flag = false  -- These are purchased parts, leaf nodes
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(lp.total_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_needed
FROM leaf_parts lp
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = lp.part_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-1981';
```

```sql
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (

    SELECT 
```
```sql
        bom.assembly_id,

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_bom AS (
    -- Get all current BOM lines (not header rows)
    SELECT 
        assembly_id,
        component_id,
        per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2025-06-30')
),
bom_paths AS (
    -- Start with all bikes in Road Bikes subcategory
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as bike_id,
        p.product_id as current_assembly_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) as cumulative_qty
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
      AND ps.name = 'Road Bikes'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand BOM
    SELECT 
        bp.bike_id,
        cb.component_id as current_assembly_id,
        bp.cumulative_qty * cb.per_assembly_qty as cumulative_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN current_bom cb ON bp.current_assembly_id = cb.assembly_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = cb.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
    )
),
all_components AS (
    -- Get all components at any level (including intermediate assemblies that are also components)
    SELECT 
        bp.bike_id,
        cb.component_id as component_id,
        bp.cumulative_qty * cb.per_assembly_qty as total_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN current_bom cb ON bp.current_assembly_id = cb.assembly_id
    
    UNION
    
    -- Also include the final parts (make_flag = false) reached at the end of recursion
    SELECT 
        bp.bike_id,
        bp.current_assembly_id as component_id,
        bp.cumulative_qty as total_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM current_bom cb WHERE cb.assembly_id = bp.current_assembly_id
    )
),
target_component AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'SR-2098'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ac.bike_id) as bike_count
FROM all_components ac
JOIN target_component tc ON ac.component_id = tc.product_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Anchor: start from the two bikes
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_code AS root_child
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code IN ('BK-R50B-44', 'BK-R79Y-44')
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand children that are manufactured in-house
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty * bt.qty,
        c.parent_code,
        bt.root_child
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON c.parent_code = bt.child_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bt.child_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
parts_in_bikes AS (
    SELECT 
        bt.child_code AS part_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bt.root_child IN (
            SELECT c.child_code FROM u_composition c 
            WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-R50B-44'
              AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
              AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
        ) OR bt.parent_code = 'BK-R50B-44' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_bike_50,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bt.root_child IN (
            SELECT c.child_code FROM u_composition c 
            WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-R79Y-44'
              AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
              AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
        ) OR bt.parent_code = 'BK-R79Y-44' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_bike_79
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bt.child_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = false  -- only purchased parts
    GROUP BY bt.child_code
)
SELECT part_number
FROM parts_in_bikes
WHERE in_bike_50 = 1 AND in_bike_79 = 0
ORDER BY part_number;
```

```sql
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number IN ('BK-T79Y-60', 'BK-M68S-38')

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for a given top-level product
bom_explode(product_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty, depth) AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the top-level product
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty,

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        be.per_assembly_qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
        be.depth + 1
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN bom_explode be ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
```

```sql
    FROM bill_of_materials b, current_date_val c
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= c.d
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR c.d <= b.end_date)
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all components for a given top-level product
-- Start with direct components of the top-level product
exploded(assembly_id, component_id, total_qty, level) AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the top-level product
    SELECT cb.assembly_id, cb.component_id, cb.per_assembly_qty, 1
    FROM current_bom cb
    WHERE cb.assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-R19B-58')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of any manufactured component
    SELECT cb.assembly_id, cb.component_id, e.total_qty * cb.per_assembly_qty, e.level + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_bom cb ON e.component_id = cb.assembly_id
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = e.component_id AND p.make_flag = true)
),

-- Get all parts (leaf nodes, i.e., purchased components) for BK-R19B-58
parts_bk_r19b AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.component_id
    FROM exploded e
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM current_bom cb WHERE cb.assembly_id = e.component_id
    )
    -- Also include the case where the top-level itself might be a part (but it's a bike, so it's manufactured)
    UNION
    -- Direct parts that have no sub-BOM
    SELECT cb.component_id
    FROM current_bom cb
    WHERE cb.assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-R19B-58')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_bom cb2 WHERE cb2.assembly_id = cb.component_id)
),

-- Same for BK-M68B-46
exploded2(assembly_id, component_id, total_qty, level) AS (
    SELECT cb.assembly_id, cb.component_id, cb.per_assembly_qty, 1
    FROM current_bom cb
    WHERE cb.assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-M68B-46')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT cb.assembly_id, cb.component_id, e.total_qty * cb.per_assembly_qty, e.level + 1
    FROM exploded2 e
    JOIN current_bom cb ON e.component_id = cb.assembly_id
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = e.component_id AND p.make_flag = true)
),

parts_bk_m68b AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.component_id
    FROM exploded2 e
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM current_bom cb WHERE cb.assembly_id = e.component_id
    )
    UNION
    SELECT cb.component_id
    FROM current_bom cb
    WHERE cb.assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'BK-M68B-46')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_bom cb2 WHERE cb2.assembly_id = cb.component_id)
)

-- Parts in BK-R19B-58 but not in BK-M68B-46
SELECT p.product_number
FROM parts_bk_r19b r
JOIN product p ON r.component_id = p.product_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parts_bk_m68b m WHERE m.component_id = r.component_id)
ORDER BY p.product_number;
```

```sql
        SELECT product_id, product_number
        FROM product
        WHERE product_number IN ('BK-R50B-44', 'BK-R79Y-44')
    ),
    -- Recursive CTE to explode BOM for a given assembly

        -- Base: start from the bike's direct components

        WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
          AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
          AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)

        -- Recursive: components that are themselves assemblies
        SELECT 
            b.assembly_id,
            b.component_id,
            eb.per_assembly_qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
            eb.depth + 1
        FROM exploded_bom eb
        JOIN bill_of_materials b ON eb.component_id = b.assembly_id
        JOIN product p ON eb.component_id = p.product_id
        WHERE p.make_flag = true
          AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
          AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
          AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
```

```sql
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN uk_territory ut ON so.territory_id = ut.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2022-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2022-12-31'
),

        sol.order_id,

        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN uk_orders_2022 so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- Start with products that have BOMs (assembly products)
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: products sold that are assemblies (have BOM lines)
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS root_product_id,
        ol.order_qty AS root_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_at_level,
        1 AS level
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = ol.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= ol.order_date 
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components that are themselves assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.root_qty,
        be.order_date,
        bom.component_id,
        be.qty_at_level * bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_at_level,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date 
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),

-- Calculate total demand for RA-7490 from BOM containment
bom_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(be.root_qty * be.qty_at_level), 0) AS total_bom_demand
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN part_ra7490 p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
),

    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN part_ra7490 p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- Get all order lines for Northeast territory in 2022
northeast_orders AS (

        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2023-01-01'
),
-- Recursive BOM explosion: find all paths from sold products to components
-- We need to track the multiplier from the root product to each component
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start from products that were sold
    SELECT 
        no.sold_product_id,
        no.sold_product_id as current_product_id,
        no.order_qty as base_qty,
        no.order_date,
        1.0::DOUBLE as multiplier,  -- Starting multiplier
        1 as level  -- Track level to avoid infinite loops, though BOM should be acyclic
    FROM northeast_orders no
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand components that are assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.sold_product_id,
        bom.component_id as current_product_id,
        be.base_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.multiplier * bom.per_assembly_qty as multiplier,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- Not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND be.level < 20  -- Safety limit for recursion
),
-- Calculate demand for RB-9231 from each order line
-- This includes: direct sales of RB-9231, and RB-9231 as a component at any level
part_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of RB-9231
    SELECT 
        no.sold_product_id,
        no.order_qty as demand
    FROM northeast_orders no
    JOIN part_info p ON no.sold_product_id = p.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- RB-9231 as a component in BOM
    SELECT 
        be.sold_product_id,
        (be.base_qty * be.multiplier)::INT as demand
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN part_info p ON be.current_product_id = p.product_id
)
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date

    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'France'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),
-- Find the product_id for part RA-2345
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'RA-2345'
),
-- Recursive BOM explosion: for each order line product, find all components at all levels
-- We need to track the original order's product_id, order_qty, and order_date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start with products that were directly ordered
    SELECT 
        fo.product_id as top_level_product_id,
        fo.order_qty,
        fo.order_date,
        fo.product_id as current_product_id,
        1.0 as qty_per_unit,
        0 as bom_level
    FROM france_orders fo
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode components
    SELECT 
        be.top_level_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        bom.component_id as current_product_id,
        be.qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty as qty_per_unit,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date

),
-- Calculate total demand for each component

        current_product_id,
        SUM(order_qty * qty_per_unit) as total_demand
    FROM bom_explosion
    GROUP BY current_product_id
)
-- Get demand for RA-2345
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the product_id for part RA-7490
part_ra7490 AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'RA-7490'
),
-- Find Canada territory
canada_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'Canada'
),
-- Get all order lines from Canada in 2025 for products that might have RA-7490 in their BOM
canada_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE so.territory_id = (SELECT territory_id FROM canada_territory)
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- Start with products that have BOM lines (are assemblies)
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base: direct components of products sold (only if they have a BOM)
    SELECT 
        co.product_id as root_product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        co.order_date,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty as qty_at_level,
        1 as bom_level
    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = co.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= co.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR co.order_date <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components of sub-assemblies that are make_flag=true (manufactured in-house)
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        bom.component_id,
        be.qty_at_level * bom.per_assembly_qty as qty_at_level,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true  -- only expand manufactured items
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Calculate total demand: direct sales of RA-7490 + all occurrences in BOMs
demand_calc AS (
    -- Direct sales of RA-7490
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(co.order_qty), 0) as direct_demand
    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    WHERE co.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM part_ra7490)
),
-- Component demand: RA-7490 appearing at any level of BOMs
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(be.qty_at_level * be.order_qty), 0) as bom_demand
    FROM bom_expansion be
    WHERE be.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM part_ra7490)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_demand FROM demand_calc) + 
    (SELECT bom_demand FROM component_demand) as total_demand_for_ra7490
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the product_id for part SH-9312
part_info AS (
    SELECT product_id AS part_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'SH-9312'
),

-- Get all order lines for Germany in 2022 with their order dates
germany_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id AS sold_product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Germany'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2023-01-01'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: find all paths from any product to part SH-9312
-- We need to explode BOMs forward: from assembly down to components
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start from products that are directly sold in orders
    -- and find their immediate components
    SELECT 
        go.sold_product_id,
        go.order_qty,
        go.order_date,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_at_level,
        1 AS level
    FROM germany_orders go
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON go.sold_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= go.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR go.order_date <= bom.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components that are assemblies themselves
    SELECT 
        be.sold_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        bom.component_id,
        be.qty_at_level * bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_at_level,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      -- Stop if we found the part we're looking for (but continue for other paths)
),

-- Calculate demand from BOM-contained units
bom_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        sold_product_id,
        order_qty,
        order_date,
        SUM(qty_at_level * order_qty) AS contained_demand
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT part_id FROM part_info)
    GROUP BY sold_product_id, order_qty, order_date
),

-- Direct sales of SH-9312
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        go.sold_product_id,
        go.order_qty,
        go.order_date,
        go.order_qty AS direct_demand
    FROM germany_orders go
    WHERE go.sold_product_id = (SELECT part_id FROM part_info)
)

-- Total demand: direct + contained
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(dd.direct_demand), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(bd.contained_demand), 0) AS total_demand
FROM (
    SELECT sold_product_id, order_qty, order_date, direct_demand FROM direct_demand
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sold_product_id, order_qty, order_date, 0 AS direct_demand FROM bom_demand WHERE (sold_product_id, order_date) NOT IN (SELECT sold_product_id, order_date FROM direct_demand)
) dd
FULL OUTER JOIN bom_demand bd 
    ON dd.sold_product_id = bd.sold_product_id 
    AND dd.order_date = bd.order_date 
    AND dd.order_qty = bd.order_qty
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the product_id for part LN-9080
part_ln9080 AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'LN-9080'
),

-- Get Canada territory
canada_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'Canada'
),

-- Get all order lines from Canada in 2025 with their order dates
canada_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id as sold_product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE so.territory_id = (SELECT territory_id FROM canada_territory)
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: find all paths from sold products to components
-- We need to track: the original sold product, the current component, quantity multiplier, and order date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start from products that have BOM lines (assemblies) or are leaf products
    -- Actually, we need to start from the sold product and explode down
    SELECT 
        co.sold_product_id,
        co.sold_product_id as current_product_id,
        co.order_qty as base_qty,
        1.0::DOUBLE as cumulative_qty,
        co.order_date,
        0 as bom_level
    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow BOM down
    SELECT 
        be.sold_product_id,
        bom.component_id as current_product_id,
        be.base_qty,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as cumulative_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),

-- Get all demand instances: both direct sales and component usage
-- Direct sales: when sold_product_id = LN-9080 (sold directly)
-- Component usage: when current_product_id = LN-9080 in the explosion
all_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of LN-9080
    SELECT 
        co.sold_product_id,
        co.order_qty as units,
        co.order_date,
        'direct' as demand_type
    FROM canada_orders_2025 co
    WHERE co.sold_product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM part_ln9080)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Component demand: where LN-9080 appears as a component in BOM explosion
    SELECT 
        be.sold_product_id,
        (be.base_qty * be.cumulative_qty)::INT as units,
        be.order_date,
        'component' as demand_type
    FROM bom_explosion be
    WHERE be.current_product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM part_ln9080)
      AND be.bom_level > 0  -- only component usage, not the root itself
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units), 0)::BIGINT as total_demand FROM all_demand
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bike_products AS (

    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id

),

),

        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id AS assembly_product_id,
        sol.product_id AS component_id,
        sol.order_qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS bom_level
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN southeast_orders so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN bike_products bp ON sol.product_id = bp.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode BOM components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.assembly_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        (be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty)::INT AS total_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bike_products AS (
    -- Get all products in Bikes category
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number, p.name
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
uk_orders AS (
    -- Get all orders from UK territory in 2025
    SELECT so.order_id
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'United Kingdom'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),
uk_order_lines AS (
    -- Get order lines for UK orders with bike products
    SELECT sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN uk_orders uo ON sol.order_id = uo.order_id
    JOIN bike_products bp ON sol.product_id = bp.product_id
),
bom_hierarchy AS (
    -- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all components at all levels
    -- Start with bike products as top-level assemblies
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id as top_level_product_id,
        bp.product_number as top_level_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bp.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse: components that are manufactured in-house have their own BOMs
    SELECT 
        bh.top_level_product_id,
        bh.top_level_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        bh.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bom_hierarchy bh
    JOIN product p ON bh.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bh.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
bike_units_sold AS (
    -- Calculate total units sold for each bike
    -- This includes: 1) direct sales of the bike itself, 2) all component demands
    SELECT 
        bp.product_number,
        COALESCE(SUM(uol.order_qty), 0) as direct_units,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN bh.component_id IS NOT NULL THEN uol.order_qty * bh.total_qty ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) as component_units
    FROM bike_products bp
    LEFT JOIN uk_order_lines uol ON bp.product_id = uol.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bom_hierarchy bh ON bp.product_id = bh.top_level_product_id
    GROUP BY bp.product_number
),
total_units AS (
    SELECT 
        product_number,
        direct_units + component_units as total_units_sold
    FROM bike_units_sold
)
SELECT product_number
FROM total_units
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, identify bikes (products in category 'Bikes')
bikes AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number, p.name
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
-- Get France territory
france_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id 
    FROM sales_territory 
    WHERE name = 'France'
),
-- Get 2025 orders from France
france_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN france_territory ft ON so.territory_id = ft.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get order lines for bikes in France in 2025
bike_order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        fo.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN france_orders_2025 fo ON sol.order_id = fo.order_id
    JOIN bikes b ON sol.product_id = b.product_id
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all components at all levels for each bike
-- We need component demand: for each bike sold, how many of each component are needed
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start with bikes as assemblies, find their direct components
    SELECT 
        b.product_id as top_level_product_id,
        b.product_number as top_level_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level,
        fo.order_date,
        fo.order_qty as order_qty
    FROM bike_order_lines fo
    JOIN bikes b ON fo.product_id = b.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = b.product_id
        AND bom.start_date <= fo.order_date 
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR fo.order_date <= bom.end_date)
        AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components that are assemblies, find their sub-components
    SELECT 
        be.top_level_product_id,
        be.top_level_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level,
        be.order_date,
        be.order_qty
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = p.product_id
        AND bom.start_date <= be.order_date 
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
        AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude header rows
    WHERE p.make_flag = true  -- only recurse on manufactured items
),
-- Calculate total units sold (direct bike sales) + component demand
-- For the question, we need "units sold" which means the bike units themselves
-- The component demand is additional context, but the question asks which bikes sold the most units
bike_units_sold AS (
    SELECT 
        b.product_number,
        SUM(sol.order_qty) as total_units_sold
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN france_orders_2025 fo ON sol.order_id = fo.order_id
    JOIN bikes b ON sol.product_id = b.product_id
    GROUP BY b.product_number
)
SELECT product_number
FROM bike_units_sold
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_hierarchy AS (
    -- Find the product_id for FR-R92B-44
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-R92B-44'
),
-- Recursive CTE to find all paths from any product down to FR-R92B-44
-- We need to find: for each product that contains FR-R92B-44 (at any level), 
-- what is the total quantity of FR-R92B-44 per unit of that product?
component_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct BOM lines where component is FR-R92B-44
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS total_component_qty,
        b.start_date,
        b.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM bom_hierarchy)
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: find products that contain assemblies that contain FR-R92B-44
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        cp.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty * cp.total_component_qty AS total_component_qty,
        GREATEST(b.start_date, cp.start_date) AS start_date,
        LEAST(COALESCE(b.end_date, '9999-12-31'::DATE), COALESCE(cp.end_date, '9999-12-31'::DATE)) AS end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN component_paths cp ON b.component_id = cp.assembly_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Also include FR-R92B-44 sold directly (as itself)
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        1.0 AS total_component_qty,
        '1900-01-01'::DATE AS start_date,
        '9999-12-31'::DATE AS end_date
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FR-R92B-44'
),
-- Combine all paths: direct sales + component usage
all_paths AS (
    SELECT product_id AS assembly_id, total_component_qty, start_date, end_date FROM direct_sales
    UNION ALL
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all orders from Central territory in 2023
central_orders_2023 AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),
-- Find the product_id for FR-M94S-38
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'FR-M94S-38'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: for each product, find all components at all levels
-- Starting from products that were ordered, walk down the BOM
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: products that were directly ordered (level 0, they "contain" themselves)
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        co.order_qty AS total_qty,
        0 AS bom_level,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS per_assembly_qty
    FROM central_orders_2023 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of the current level
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1,
        bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      -- Only recurse if the current component is a manufactured assembly (has its own BOM)
      -- Actually we need to follow all paths, but the join naturally stops when no BOM lines exist
),
-- Calculate total demand: for each path, multiply quantities along the path
-- We need to aggregate: for each (order, component), sum over all paths
demand_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        order_date,
        root_product_id,
        component_id,
        -- total_qty is the order quantity, and we need to multiply by all per_assembly_qty along the path
        -- But in our recursive CTE, we didn't accumulate the product. Let me redo.
        total_qty,
        per_assembly_qty,
        bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion
)
-- Let me restart with proper quantity accumulation
,
bom_explosion_v2 AS (
    -- Base case: products that were directly ordered
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        co.order_qty AS accumulated_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM central_orders_2023 co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.accumulated_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion_v2 be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
)
-- Sum all demand for FR-M94S-38
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(accumulated_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM bom_explosion_v2
WHERE component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product);
```

```sql
    WHERE st.name = 'Australia'

      AND so.order_date < '2025-01-01'

-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product sold, find all components at all levels

    -- This handles direct sales of FR-T67Y-62

        0 as bom_level
    FROM product p

        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as cumulative_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row

      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= bom.end_date)

-- So let's restructure: for each order line, expand its product's BOM as of the order date

    SELECT

        ao.order_date,
        ao.product_id as root_product_id,
        ao.order_qty,
        -- The product itself
        ao.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as per_unit_qty
    FROM australia_orders ao

        ao.order_date,
        ao.product_id as root_product_id,
        ao.order_qty,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty

      AND bom.start_date <= ao.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR ao.order_date <= bom.end_date)

recursive_expansion AS (

        order_date,
        root_product_id,
        order_qty,
        component_id,
        per_unit_qty
    FROM order_line_components

    SELECT 
        re.order_id,
        re.order_date,
        re.root_product_id,
        re.order_qty,
        bom.component_id,
        re.per_unit_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: find the product and its direct BOM components valid on 2021-06-10
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS root_product_id,
        p.product_number AS root_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM product p
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-T18U-50'
      AND bom.start_date <= '2021-06-10'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2021-06-10')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode components that are manufactured in-house (make_flag = true)
    SELECT 
        be.root_product_id,
        be.root_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        be.qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
        be.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= '2021-06-10'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2021-06-10')
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Anchor: find the product BK-M47B-48
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_number,
        p.name,
        p.standard_cost,
        p.make_flag,
        1.0 AS per_unit_qty,
        1 AS bom_level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-M47B-48'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find components of assemblies
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_number,
        p.name,
        p.standard_cost,
        p.make_flag,
        bt.per_unit_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS per_unit_qty,
        bt.bom_level + 1 AS bom_level
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = bt.product_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE bt.make_flag = true  -- only expand assemblies
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2021-08-06'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2021-08-06')
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(per_unit_qty * standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM bom_tree
WHERE make_flag = false;  -- only purchased parts
```

```sql
        be.child_code,

            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to

    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN bom_edges be ON bp.item_code = be.parent_code

      AND (be.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.valid_from <= be.valid_to)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Base case: start with product BK-T79U-60
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        c.unit
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-T79U-60'
        AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= c.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow the BOM down
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        b.qty_per_unit * c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        c.unit
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c ON b.child_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= c.valid_to)
),
parts AS (
    -- Get all leaf nodes that are purchased parts (make_flag = false)
    SELECT 
        b.child_code,
        b.qty_per_unit
    FROM bom b
    JOIN product p ON b.child_code = p.product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include any intermediate nodes that are purchased parts
    -- (in case a purchased part has no children in the BOM, or we need to catch make_flag=false at any level)
    SELECT 
        b.child_code,
        b.qty_per_unit
    FROM bom b
    JOIN product p ON b.child_code = p.product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
),
-- Deduplicate and sum quantities for same part across all paths
part_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        child_code,
        SUM(qty_per_unit) AS total_qty_per_unit
    FROM parts
    GROUP BY child_code
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(pt.total_qty_per_unit * p.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM part_totals pt
JOIN product p ON pt.child_code = p.product_number;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the territory_id for United Kingdom
uk_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id 
    FROM sales_territory 
    WHERE name = 'United Kingdom'
),

-- Get all order lines from UK in 2022 with their order dates and product info
uk_orders_2022 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date,
        p.product_number
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN uk_territory ut ON so.territory_id = ut.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2022-01-01' 
      AND so.order_date <= '2022-12-31'
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from sold products to components
-- Start with the products sold directly (these are the "parents" in BOM)
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: the product itself (0 levels down)
    SELECT 
        uo.order_id,
        uo.line_id,
        uo.product_number as parent_code,
        uo.product_number as child_code,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) as qty_per_unit,
        uo.order_date,
        uo.order_qty,
        0 as level
    FROM uk_orders_2022 uo
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow BOM edges
    SELECT 
        bp.order_id,
        bp.line_id,
        uc.parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
        bp.qty_per_unit * uc.qty as qty_per_unit,
        bp.order_date,
        bp.order_qty,
        bp.level + 1
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON bp.child_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= bp.order_date 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Calculate total demand for each component in each order line
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        line_id,
        child_code as component_code,
        SUM(qty_per_unit * order_qty) as total_demand
    FROM bom_paths
    GROUP BY order_id, line_id, child_code
)

-- Sum total demand for RA-7490
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_demand), 0) as total_demand_for_ra_7490
FROM component_demand
WHERE component_code = 'RA-7490'
```

```sql
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2022-12-31'

-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all components at all levels
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of products sold
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.line_id,
        no.order_qty,
        no.order_date,
        no.product_number AS root_product_number,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty AS component_qty,
        uc.qty * no.order_qty AS total_component_qty

    WHERE uc.valid_from <= no.order_date 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR no.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_number,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty AS component_qty,
        uc.qty * be.total_component_qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.child_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),
-- Get leaf parts (make_flag = false) from the expansion
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_number,
        be.child_code,
        be.total_component_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN product p ON be.child_code = p.product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
),

direct_sales AS (

    FROM northeast_orders_2022 no
    WHERE no.product_number = 'RB-9231'

    FROM leaf_parts lp
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Southwest territory in 2022 with their order dates and quantities
southwest_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Southwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2023-01-01'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from sold products to part SH-4562
-- We need to track: starting product, the path multiplier, and the order date for validity
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct composition edges where child is SH-4562
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as root_product_id,
        p.product_number as root_product_number,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty as path_qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM product p
    JOIN u_composition c ON p.product_number = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.child_code = 'SH-4562'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go up the BOM (find parents of current root)
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as root_product_id,
        p.product_number as root_product_number,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty * bp.path_qty as path_qty,
        GREATEST(c.valid_from, bp.valid_from) as valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(c.valid_to, bp.valid_to)
        END as valid_to
    FROM product p
    JOIN u_composition c ON p.product_number = c.parent_code
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON c.child_code = bp.root_product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = true  -- only manufactured products have BOMs
),
-- Get the total demand: for each order line, multiply by all valid BOM paths to SH-4562
demand_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_qty,
        so.order_date,
        so.product_id,
        COALESCE(bp.path_qty, 0) as bom_qty
    FROM southwest_orders so
    LEFT JOIN bom_paths bp ON so.product_id = bp.root_product_id
        AND bp.valid_from <= so.order_date
        AND (bp.valid_to IS NULL OR so.order_date <= bp.valid_to)
),
-- Sum up: direct sales of SH-4562 + component demand from all levels
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_qty), 0) as direct_qty
    FROM southwest_orders so
    JOIN product p ON so.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'SH-4562'
),
component_demand AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_qty * bom_qty), 0) as component_qty
    FROM demand_calc
    WHERE bom_qty > 0
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_qty FROM direct_sales) + 
    (SELECT component_qty FROM component_demand) as total_demand
```

```sql
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'

    SELECT 
```
```sql
        uc.parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
```

```sql
        uc.valid_to
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.child_code = 'FR-T67U-54'
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code,
        bp.parent_code AS child_code,  -- the previous parent becomes the child in our traversal
        uc.qty * bp.total_qty AS total_qty,
        GREATEST(uc.valid_from, bp.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL AND bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(uc.valid_to, bp.valid_to)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of BK-R68R-48 in current BOM
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        p.make_flag
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = c.child_code
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-R68R-48'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of manufactured components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        p.make_flag
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = e.child_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = c.child_code
    WHERE e.make_flag = true  -- only explode manufactured components
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT child_code) AS distinct_parts
FROM bom_explosion
WHERE make_flag = false;
```

```sql
-- Get all components of BK-R19B-58 at any level, current BOM (as of 2025-06-30)
components_r19b AS (
    -- Base: direct children of BK-R19B-58
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-R19B-58'
        AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: children of any make_flag=true child
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        p.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM components_r19b p
    JOIN u_composition c ON p.item_code = c.parent_code
    JOIN product pr ON p.item_code = pr.product_number
    WHERE pr.make_flag = true
        AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get all components of BK-M68B-46 at any level, current BOM (as of 2025-06-30)
components_m68b AS (
    -- Base: direct children of BK-M68B-46
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-M68B-46'
        AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: children of any make_flag=true child
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        p.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM components_m68b p
    JOIN u_composition c ON p.item_code = c.parent_code
    JOIN product pr ON p.item_code = pr.product_number
    WHERE pr.make_flag = true
        AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get distinct parts (make_flag = false) from BK-R19B-58
parts_r19b AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT item_code
    FROM components_r19b c
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get current BOM components for BK-T79Y-60
bom_t79y AS (
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-T79Y-60'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        t.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(t.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN t.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(t.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_t79y t ON c.parent_code = t.item_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND GREATEST(t.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= LEAST(COALESCE(t.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(c.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'))
),
-- Aggregate quantities for BK-T79Y-60 (sum over all paths and time intervals)
t79y_parts AS (
    SELECT item_code
    FROM bom_t79y
    GROUP BY item_code
),
-- Get current BOM components for BK-M68S-38
bom_m68s AS (
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-M68S-38'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        t.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(t.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN t.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(t.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_m68s t ON c.parent_code = t.item_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND GREATEST(t.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= LEAST(COALESCE(t.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(c.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'))
),
-- Aggregate quantities for BK-M68S-38
m68s_parts AS (
    SELECT item_code
    FROM bom_m68s
    GROUP BY item_code
)
-- Parts in BK-T79Y-60 but not in BK-M68S-38
SELECT DISTINCT t.item_code
FROM t79y_parts t
LEFT JOIN m68s_parts m ON t.item_code = m.item_code
WHERE m.item_code IS NULL
ORDER BY t.item_code;
```

```sql
WITH 
-- Get all order lines for Northeast territory in 2022 with their order dates and quantities
northeast_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.order_qty,
        p.product_number
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id

    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2022-12-31'
),
-- For each order line, find the BOM-exploded components valid on that order date
-- We need to match order_date against u_explosion intervals
exploded_components AS (
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.order_qty,
        no.product_number,
        ue.item_code,
        ue.qty AS component_qty_per_unit
    FROM northeast_orders no
    JOIN u_explosion ue ON no.product_number = ue.root_code
    WHERE no.order_date >= ue.valid_from
      AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR no.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
),
-- Calculate total demand: direct sales (where product itself is RB-9231) + component usage
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(order_qty) AS direct_units
    FROM northeast_orders
    WHERE product_number = 'RB-9231'
),
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(order_qty * component_qty_per_unit) AS component_units
    FROM exploded_components
    WHERE item_code = 'RB-9231'
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE((SELECT direct_units FROM direct_demand), 0) + 
    COALESCE((SELECT component_units FROM component_demand), 0) AS total_demand_for_RB_9231
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all Northeast territory orders in 2023
northeast_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty, p.product_number
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),
-- Recursive BOM explosion: find all paths from products sold to their components
-- We need to find demand for 'FK-1639' both as direct sales and as component
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: products sold directly that are FK-1639
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.product_number as root_code,
        no.product_number as item_code,
        no.order_qty as qty,
        1.0 as multiplier,
        no.order_qty as total_qty
    FROM northeast_orders no
    WHERE no.product_number = 'FK-1639'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: start from products sold that have BOMs containing FK-1639
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.product_number as root_code,
        uc.child_code as item_code,
        no.order_qty as qty,
        uc.qty as multiplier,
        no.order_qty * uc.qty as total_qty
    FROM northeast_orders no
    JOIN u_composition uc ON no.product_number = uc.parent_code
    WHERE no.product_number != 'FK-1639'
      AND no.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR no.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: continue down the BOM
    SELECT 
        bp.order_id,
        bp.order_date,
        bp.root_code,
        uc.child_code as item_code,
        bp.qty,
        bp.multiplier * uc.qty as multiplier,
        bp.qty * bp.multiplier * uc.qty as total_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON bp.item_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE bp.item_code != 'FK-1639'  -- stop if we found our target
      AND bp.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),
-- Filter to only FK-1639 demands and sum
fk1639_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        order_date,
        root_code,
        total_qty as demand
    FROM bom_paths
    WHERE item_code = 'FK-1639'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(demand), 0) as total_demand
FROM fk1639_demand
```
